capabilities: compile raw/ notes into structured wiki pages with concepts, entities and sources
browse the wiki via card index, page viewer, backlinks and SVG mind map
chat with the knowledge base and get answers citing wiki-links
run embedding-based vector search with keyword fallback
detect broken links, generate stub pages and auto-link related pages
extras: Desktop only (streaming chat needs the fetch API). Free and open source (MIT); API calls go directly from the device to the configured provider. Developer/build docs live in a separate CONTRIBUTING.md. Wiki cleanup requires typing CONFIRM.
problem: Scattered, unconnected notes are hard to navigate and reuse; it automates extracting concepts and building the linked wiki structure manually linking would require.

relations.evidence: Multi-LLM | DeepSeek, OpenAI, Claude, OpenRouter, any OpenAI-compatible API

requires.name: LLM API key (DeepSeek recommended; OpenAI-compatible providers supported)
LLM provider usage billed per token

summary: AI knowledge compiler that turns notes in a raw/ folder into a linked wiki with concept pages, backlinks, semantic search and cited AI chat.
